rules.statement: A deed transferring property for the use of a specified sect of Buddhist priests, with trustees to sell the property and apply proceeds to benefit an institution, does not violate section 41 of Ordinance No. 8 of 1905.
rules.supporting_quote: "The object of the section it not to control gifts of money, but to control the permanent tying up of land. The interest conferred in this case is not in the land, bat in the proceeds of its sale."
